source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. A warm, spiritual canyon village at sunset: red rock walls glowing orange, wind over the mesa, elders telling ancestral stories by the fire. Earthy, nostalgic and deeply peaceful, with a sense of ancient wisdom and belonging. Soft fingerpicked acoustic guitar carries the chords, a breathy pan flute (and an ocarina answering it) sings a simple, heartfelt pentatonic-tinged melody, gentle hand drums keep a relaxed heartbeat groove, with a low warm drone underneath. Wistful, open fifths, a little melancholy but hopeful. Tempo 88 BPM, 3/4 time, key of C major. Instrumentation: fingerpicked nylon and steel acoustic guitars, pan flute lead, ocarina answer, hand drums and frame drum, soft shaker, rain stick, warm bass drone, light hand-played percussion. Form: guitar intro phrase, pan flute theme, ocarina answer phrase, theme again with fuller percussion. Duration: 90 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
